text: Electrical Engineering and Its Automation is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates power systems, electronic technology, control theory and computer technology. Its core focus is on the production, transmission, distribution, conversion and automatic control of electrical energy. From the planning of urban power grids to the driving of industrial robots, from new energy power stations to smart home systems, this major covers the entire chain of power energy and automatic control, and is one of the basic disciplines that support modern industrial civilization and intelligent society.
